task.description:
Write test specifications and integration test code for AGT-01, AGT-02, AGT-03, AGT-04.

Read each requirement: python tools/reqctl.py show AGT-01 (and AGT-02, AGT-03, AGT-04).
Read the design: src/design/AGT-01-04-agent-artifacts.md
Read the implementation: src/api/routes/agent_artifacts.zig
Read existing test patterns in tests/ and tests/specs/

Deliver:
1. Test spec: tests/specs/AGT-01-04.md covering all 24 ACs (6 per requirement)
2. Integration test file in tests/ following existing naming patterns for the test suite

Test coverage requirements (every AC must have at least one test):

AGT-01:
- TC-AGT-01-01: kind=test_report with valid payload → HTTP 201 (or 200 on re-hit) + kind column in DB row
- TC-AGT-01-02: kind=patch_set with test_report payload → HTTP 422 artifact_payload_invalid with JSON pointer
- TC-AGT-01-03: kind=benchmark (unknown) → HTTP 400 unknown_artifact_kind naming value + listing 4 accepted
- TC-AGT-01-04: kind=design_artifact with unknown field in payload → HTTP 422 (closed schema rejects unknown members)
- TC-AGT-01-05: GET /api/v1/agent/artifacts/schemas → 200 with catalog of all 4 schemas versioned
- TC-AGT-01-06: DB row query filtered by kind returns only matching rows

AGT-02:
- TC-AGT-02-01: production deployment + valid envelope → HTTP 403 wrong_environment
- TC-AGT-02-02: production deployment + valid envelope (env check before schema validation, invalid payload still yields 403 not 422)
- TC-AGT-02-03: request body with "environment":"staging" on production → discarded, returns 403
- TC-AGT-02-04: staging deployment + valid envelope → HTTP 201, row in staging.agent_artifacts
- TC-AGT-02-05: after rejection on production, ArtifactSubmissionRejected audit event written
- TC-AGT-02-06 (SEC-AGT-02): cross-tenant artifact lookup and not-found return byte-identical responses

AGT-03:
- TC-AGT-03-01: no row exists → HTTP 201, xmax=0, new artifact_id
- TC-AGT-03-02: same triple, same spec_hash resubmitted → HTTP 200, original artifact_id, touched_at advances, payload unchanged
- TC-AGT-03-03: same triple, different spec_hash → HTTP 409 spec_hash_mismatch with both hashes
- TC-AGT-03-04: simulated network retry (identical envelope, server already committed) → HTTP 200, exactly one DB row
- TC-AGT-03-05: attempt_count < max stored for this task_spec_id → HTTP 409 attempt_count_regressed
- TC-AGT-03-06: two concurrent submissions of same triple → exactly one HTTP 201, one HTTP 200 or 409

AGT-04:
- TC-AGT-04-01: two canonical forms of same doc (different key order) → same spec_hash
- TC-AGT-04-02: number 1.0 vs 1 → RFC 8785 normalises to same hash
- TC-AGT-04-03: update attempt on stored task_spec → HTTP 409 task_spec_immutable
- TC-AGT-04-04: different doc (one field changed) → different spec_hash, different task_spec_id
- TC-AGT-04-05: artifact submitted with spec_hash not in tenant's task_specs → HTTP 404 task_spec_not_found
- TC-AGT-04-06: orchestrator_principal included in spec_hash (spec re-registered with different principal → different hash)

All tests must be isolated (own fixtures, no shared state). Follow the existing integration test pattern in tests/.
